interpretation_boundaries: Protocol differences are verified facts; their causal contributions to the observed performance gap have not been isolated.
Paper Table2 supports that untied LeWM can outperform LeHami in planning, not a claim about the current rollout benchmark.
Current undamped positive control also underperforms LeWM; dissipation alone is not established as the failure mechanism.
Do not attribute the whole gap to readout capacity or geometry; new probe-only checks are diagnostics and do not establish a complete mechanism.
Author code, paper results, current controlled adaptation, and hypotheses must be reported separately.
